metadata.description: Plugins for running an AI-native software development lifecycle with Claude Code

plugins.name: ai-native-sdlc
plugins.description: The shared half of the AI-native SDLC: skills that write intent.md, spec.md and plan.md; verifier, simplifier and researcher agents; user-invocable skills for each stage gate and an /adopt skill for existing repos; and guardrail hooks that protect tests during a fix and keep secrets out of the diff.

plugins.name: gh-account-guard
plugins.description: Holds gh and git push calls whose repo owner needs a different GitHub account than the one the call would use, and offers to switch first.

plugins.name: codex-job-board
plugins.description: Tracks OpenAI Codex CLI runs started from Bash: /codex pane and status-line entry with session id, elapsed time, status and token usage.

plugins.name: tasks-band
plugins.description: Draws done/total from the project TASKS.md and the next open item in a band above the prompt.
